source_document: Canada Bay DCP Part K (Special Precincts)
note: Part K covers 24 precincts across 474 pages. 3 are extracted here as PROOF OF CONCEPT: Abbotsford Cove and Bibby Street (small, self-contained sites), plus Rhodes East (a genuinely important precinct — see its own boundary_detection note for why). The remaining 21 precincts (including Rhodes West, ~90 pages) were NOT extracted. ALL entries here are reference/citation-only — NOT wired into /envelope and NOT auto-applied to any address, because unlike zone/height/heritage, there is no live NSW spatial layer that can confirm whether a given lot actually falls inside a named Special Precinct boundary. A human must confirm precinct membership manually before relying on any control listed here.

precincts.location_description: Bounded by Great North Road, Blackwall Point Road, Walton Crescent and Melrose Crescent, Abbotsford. Includes Abbotsford House.
precincts.boundary_detection: NOT DETERMINABLE FROM ADDRESS ALONE. The precinct boundary exists only as a hand-drawn outline on an aerial photo in the source document — there is no queryable NSW spatial layer for Special Precincts (checked: EPI_Primary_Planning_Layers has Heritage/FSR/Zoning/Lot Size/Height/Land Application only, no Precinct layer). A human must confirm whether a given lot actually falls inside this precinct before applying anything below.

precincts.location_description: A large priority urban renewal precinct covering much of the Rhodes peninsula east of the railway line, City of Canada Bay. Effectively its own standalone DCP ("Rhodes East Development Control Plan") layered on top of the base Canada Bay DCP.
precincts.boundary_detection: NOT DETERMINABLE FROM ADDRESS ALONE — same core limitation as every other Part K precinct: no live NSW spatial layer marks the Rhodes East boundary. HOWEVER: unlike Bibby Street, the values below (building separation, podium/tower design, floor-to-ceiling heights) are stated in clear prose/tables, not locked inside a diagram, so they are reliably extracted once a human confirms the address is actually within Rhodes East. Max building HEIGHT and FSR are explicitly NOT included here because Rhodes East's own text says these come from the LEP 'Height of Building' map — the SAME live NSW layer /envelope already queries for every address — so that number is very likely already correct without any of this reference data.
